metadata.purpose: Structural input freeze; no schedule, energy or temperature result.

evidence_labels.paper: Published experiment, specification or aggregate (see source locator).
evidence_labels.artifact: Public software or configuration evidence; inspect exact setting.
evidence_labels.assumption: Common simulation convention frozen prior to any comparison.
evidence_labels.unknown: Unbounded or unverified for this exact workload and platform; null blocks execution.

platform.activation: Kim's JEDI ReLU network variants in place of leaky ReLU

inference_version.output_equivalence: Same per-app weights, input bytes, preprocessing and postprocessing required. Check detection outputs against the same FP16 reference with a declared numerical tolerance before claiming equivalent accuracy.

platform.source: Kim §§3, 6.1; software artifact exact target engines and model provenance unverified.

stage_encoding.residency: Load all four applications once before time zero; retain engines until the full window ends. Startup deserialization excluded; any resident idle consumption during the window included.
stage_encoding.binding: The A/C application-0 assignment follows the Table 3 DLA0/DLA1 convention. The physical IDs for its case-b partners are fixed simulation bindings. One resident engine per listed DLA stage.

A.case: case-b counterfactual using Table 9(a) case-alpha YOLOv2 option A; partner cut points from case beta

C.case: case-beta composition in Table 9(a); YOLOv2 option C

fsm.scene_source: Fig. 5(b) and Table 6; equal dwell assumed in the paper; start, order and exact dwell here are design choices.

workload.unit: all releases, deadlines and the window below are exact integer multiples of the selected period
workload.image_rank_basis: Sort distinct COCO 2017 validation images by numeric COCO image_id in the official annotations (one-based). Use the indicated rank with identical image bytes for both deployments; freeze file digests at measurement intake.
workload.evaluation_end: [0,5 periods); all last-scene jobs (if feasible) finish by 4 periods, completion exactly at the deadline is legal. No releases in [4,5). Count all idle and thermal power in the tail.
workload.deadline_policy: A scene is deadline-feasible only if all its required jobs including postprocessing have completed by its boundary. Retain pending work when recording a miss; never accept that trajectory as deadline-feasible or compare its energy as a saving.
workload.pairing: For each FPS and common frequency triplet, both candidates reference these same requests. Each trial restarts from the same specified initial physical state, then carries thermal state continuously.

clock_policy.scope: For each paired input fix one common triplet before time zero, held throughout busy, idle and tail; no transition within the window. Each of the 27 triplets is a separate unexecuted certification case.
clock_policy.board_control: Require MAXN, eight CPU cores online, both DLAs enabled. Request min=max where supported and verify achieved clocks under load, including each DLA; check thermal/power throttles. MAXN alone neither locks clocks nor bounds DC power at 30 W. If the requested clocks cannot be held, the fixed-clock input is not realized.
clock_policy.outside_domains: Require the same declared EMC, fan/cooling and peripheral settings for both members of each pair; match those settings to the timing, power and thermal evidence before use.
clock_policy.source: Selected Table 7 frequencies; holding all three domains constant including both DLA resources and idle intervals is a shared model policy.

cpu.app_core_mapping: Each application uses CPU<app_id> for both pre and post processing; CPU4–7 have no scheduled application work.

accelerators.dispatch: An exclusive, work-conserving FIFO queue per physical resource, dispatch whole ready stages nonpreemptively. Process all completions and releases at one timestamp before dispatch on free resources.
accelerators.caveat: The GPU whole-stage queue approximates the paper's finer kernel-level stream interference. Do not reuse an original hard response bound for this rule.

execution_policy.order: CPU pre, all listed inference stages in order, CPU post. No request can exit early or change its mapping. Equality of ready times uses the ranks above.
execution_policy.edge_costs: Capture every handoff including DLA0 to DLA1 where applicable. Charge format, copy and synchronization work exactly once to the profile for the actual engine boundary or to its measured resource subevents, and mark that choice. No default zero transfer or inference by layer counts.
execution_policy.measurement_boundary: If transition kernels are embedded in a measured engine stage, do not add them again as edge costs. External resource subevents require explicit timing, ownership and precedence at intake; hidden GPU fallback invalidates a nominal DLA-only stage unless separately characterized and the input revised.

thermal.merged_dla: One lumped simulation thermal node sums DLA0 and DLA1 heat, including overlapping execution. Their scheduling resources remain separate. This node is not a measured die topology or a per-core hotspot safety guarantee.
thermal.continuous: Keep the full state vector across all four segments and the tail. Independently evaluated scenes reset to the exact same common reference vector at each segment start only in diagnostic calculations; the final segment and its tail form one continuous unit.
thermal.safety: A safety claim requires validated continuous peaks through active and idle intervals, including the tail.

energy.measurement_boundary: DC input of the defined complete board under a fixed peripheral and cooling configuration
energy.integral: Integrate board input power over [0,5 periods) at the declared FPS, including resident idle consumption, regulator/peripheral/base load, activity, thermal leakage and the full tail. Count concurrent engines jointly; avoid double-counting rail and total measurements.
energy.response_convention: Typical-energy execution traces need measured duration/response distributions or a declared bounded representative. Deadline certification needs separate conservative duration bounds and interference coverage; ACET never substitutes for WCET.
